unitTitle: B2 · Technology and privacy: reason through possibilities
title: Words: core topic language — set 5
subtitle: B2 · Unit 6: B2 · Technology and privacy: reason through possibilities

steps.exampleFr: Chaque connexion peut laisser une trace numérique.
steps.exampleEn: Each login can leave a digital trace.

steps.exampleFr: Le texte distingue l'usage principal d'un usage secondaire.
steps.exampleEn: The text distinguishes primary use from secondary use.

steps.exampleFr: Le sondage permet de rester anonyme.
steps.exampleEn: The survey allows participants to remain anonymous.

steps.exampleFr: Une collecte minimale limite les renseignements conservés.
steps.exampleEn: Minimal data collection limits the information retained.

steps.exampleFr: Le titulaire change son mot de passe après l'alerte sur un compte compromis.
steps.exampleEn: The account holder changes the password after an alert about a compromised account.

steps.exampleFr: Le service précise que le consentement est révocable.
steps.exampleEn: The service explains that consent can be withdrawn.

steps.explain: une trace numérique means a digital trace.
un usage secondaire means secondary use.
rester anonyme means to remain anonymous.
une collecte minimale means minimal data collection.
un compte compromis means a compromised account.
un consentement révocable means revocable consent.
